sentences.text:
(D) Pending admission and till final disposal of the present petition, be pleased to direct the respondent authorities to initiate proceedings to pay the advance compensation to the petitioners for the acquired lands of the petitioners for the purpose of Amudh-Chandalaj (Chandravati) Road, situated at Village: Amudh,
Taluka: Unjha, District: Mehsana, (E) Grant such other and further relief(s) in the fact and circumstances of the present petitions as deemed fit in the interest of justice."
2
It is the case of the petitioners that the possession of the lands of the petitioners were taken away long back and proceedings under the land acquisition has been initiated.

3 On 02.03.2023, this Court passed the following order:
"As a last chance, time is granted to all concerned to see that the acquisition proceedings with regard to the land in question begins before the next date of hearing, failing which the District Collector of Mahesana shall remain personally present before this Court at 11:00 a.m on 21.03.2023.
Stand over to 21.03.2023."

Today, when the matter is called out, learned AGP Ms.Shrunjal Shah, states that proceedings have already been initiated and within a period of one week from today, appropriate notification shall be issued.
She further states that the entire procedure of acquisition shall be completed within eight weeks including declaration of award.

5 In view of the above statement, we dispose of this petition with a direction to the respondent authorities to complete the proceedings within a period of three months, including declaring the award.
The petition is disposed of, accordingly.

opennyai_summary.decision:
By way of present petition under Article 14, 300-A and 226 of the Constitution of India, following prayers have been made:
"20 (A) Admit this petition;
(B) Allow this petition by issuing an appropriate writ, order or direction directing the respondent authorities to complete the acquisition proceedings of the lands of the petitioners, which is acquired for the purpose of Amudh chandalaj (Chandravati)
(C) Further be pleased to direct the respondent C
/ SCA/6968/2022 ORDER DATED:
21/03/2023 authorities to pass appropriate order to pay 80% advance compensation to the petitioners as provided under the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 during pendency of the acquisition proceedings of the lands of the petitioners;
(D) Pending admission and till final disposal of the present petition, be pleased to direct the respondent authorities to initiate proceedings to pay the advance compensation to the petitioners for the acquired lands of the petitioners for the purpose of Amudh-Chandalaj (Chandravati) Road, situated at Village: Amudh,
Taluka: Unjha, District: Mehsana, (E) Grant such other and further relief(s) in the fact and circumstances of the present petitions as deemed fit in the interest of justice."
2
3 On 02.03.2023, this Court passed the following order:
"As a last chance, time is granted to all concerned to see that the acquisition proceedings with regard to the land in question begins before the next date of hearing, failing which the District Collector of Mahesana shall remain personally present before this Court at 11:00 a.m on 21.03.2023.
Stand over to 21.03.2023."
Today, when the matter is called out, learned AGP Ms.Shrunjal Shah, states that proceedings have already been initiated and within a period of one week from today, appropriate notification shall be issued.
She further states that the entire procedure of acquisition shall be completed within eight weeks including declaration of award.
5 In view of the above statement, we dispose of this petition with a direction to the respondent authorities to complete the proceedings within a period of three months, including declaring the award.
The petition is disposed of, accordingly.
Direct service is permitted.
